name: Quantum-Dot-Based Volumetric Display
definition: A volumetric display system using quantum dots (QDs) embedded in a polymer substrate to eliminate occlusion caused by electrical wiring. External light irradiation excites the QDs, causing them to emit light spontaneously, forming visible voxels without internal power connections.
summary: A volumetric display embedding quantum dots in polymer to emit light via external excitation, eliminating occlusion from wiring and defining voxels through physical material placement rather than internal power connections.
